Project a Supplementary Assessor's Distances

Source: R/distatis.R
project_distance.Rd

Project a Supplementary Assessor's Distances

Usage

project_distance(x, new_data, squared = x$squared, ...)

# S3 method for class 'distatis'
project(x, new_data, ...)

# S3 method for class 'distatis'
project_cov(x, new_data, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted distatis model.

new_data

A distance matrix or dist object on the fitted objects in their original order. This projects a new assessor, not new objects.

squared

Whether new distances are already squared. Defaults to the setting used when fitting x.

...

Unused arguments, rejected.

Value

An object-by-component partial score matrix. The fitted compromise and assessor weights remain fixed.

See also

project_subjects(), distatis()
